name: progress
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Progress bar for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned ARIA progressbar primitive. The indicator's fill width is CSS-transform-driven from the primitive's --progress-value custom property; a `None` value renders a zero-filled indeterminate bar rather than upstream's unstyled indeterminate state, since animated indeterminate styling is M4's job.
